summary: Military air exercise with high energy manoeuvres near Whorlton Moor, up to 9,000 feet above sea level within 3.2 nautical miles.
text:
AIR EXER. WILL CONDUCT HIGH ENERGY MANOEUVRES IN SUPPORT OF
GROUND OPS WI 3.2NM RADIUS OF 542343N 0011637W (WHORLTON MOOR).
ACFT MAY OPERATE AT SPEEDS OF UP TO 450 KNOTS IAS AND MAY BE
UNABLE TO COMPLY WITH RAC. FOR FURTHER INFO AIC Y007/2023 REFERS.
OPS CTC FREQ 271.400MHZ FOR INFO 07972 787428. AR-2026-11174/01.
